title: Port Codex tmux session launch from tripletex1 main.ts
description: Port the tmux-based Codex session launch mechanism from tripletex1/src/main.ts into tripletex2. This is how production /solve requests execute: launch a Codex agent in a tmux window, wait for completion, capture the session trace. Must match tripletex1 behavior 1:1.

title: Port trusted standards into 1-to-1 TypeScript strategy implementations
description: For each of the 18 trusted standards in tripletex1/codex-environment/trusted-standards/, implement a matching deterministic TypeScript strategy in tripletex2/src/tasks/. Use the trusted standard as the exact implementation spec. This replaces the UnimplementedError stubs with real executable code.

title: Port sandbox credential management (.sandbox.env)
description: Port the .sandbox.env credential loading convention from tripletex1. Support TRIPLETEX_TEST_BASE_URL and TRIPLETEX_TEST_SESSION_TOKEN for sandbox/testing mode, with env-var override and file-based fallback. Also port TRIPLETEX_SUBMISSIONS_ACCESS_TOKEN for the submissions API.

title: Port all task playbooks from tripletex1 as reference docs
description: Copy all 18 task playbooks from tripletex1/codex-environment/task-playbooks/ into tripletex2/docs/task-playbooks/. These are supplementary production-proven learnings per task that coding agents should read when implementing or improving strategies.

title: Port leaderboard polling and task attribution from tripletex1
description: Port the post-run leaderboard polling from tripletex1/src/main.ts. After a solve completes, poll the competition leaderboard API, diff before/after snapshots, infer which tx_task_id was affected, and write task-attribution.json + enrich the canonical artifact's attribution block.

title: Production-ready tripletex2 runtime parity with tripletex1
description: Make tripletex2 the canonical single working solution branch by reaching full runtime parity with tripletex1 production infrastructure. Does NOT include the post-run reflection loop.

title: Port submission score polling and evaluation from tripletex1
description: Port the post-run submission score polling from tripletex1/src/main.ts. After a solve completes, poll the submissions API, match the run to a submission entry, extract the normalized score and feedback, and write submission-score.json + enrich the canonical artifact's evaluation block.

title: Update task registry to canonical tx_task_id numbering (01-18)
description: Map all 18 tasks to their competition tx_task_id numbers. Update the registry, the legacy bridge, and all reporting to use these IDs consistently. This is the foundation for all other migration work.

title: Tripletex2 iteration-ready deterministic strategy system
description:
Build the tripletex2 iteration-ready system: deterministic task registry, strategy runtime, canonical run logging, replay/comparison tooling, and at least one proven end-to-end task with multiple strategies.

Intent:
- finish the architecture freeze in code-facing form
- implement runtime + tracking so we can iterate on strategies deliberately
- end with a system where adding/improving task strategies becomes routine rather than ad hoc

This is the umbrella feature for the remaining refactor work.

title: Freeze shared runtime contracts in code
description:
Freeze the shared code-level contracts used by all tasks and strategies.

Deliverables:
- canonical `TaskSpec` type
- canonical `TaskStrategy` type
- canonical `StrategyContext` and `StrategyResult`
- exact required metadata and field names
- one source-of-truth location under `src/runtime/` or equivalent

This task converts the current docs into stable code-facing contracts.

title: Implement end-to-end deterministic solve pipeline
description:
Implement the end-to-end solve pipeline shell.

Deliverables:
- classify request
- extract typed input
- load task spec
- resolve active strategy
- execute strategy
- emit run artifact

This can be minimal at first, but it must exercise the intended architecture directly.

title: Implement replay harness for stored requests
description:
Implement a replay harness over the curated/training request corpus.

Deliverables:
- replay one stored request through the new pipeline
- support selecting a request fixture deterministically
- write artifacts under the canonical run layout

This is the main development loop before real competition runs.

title: Implement derived reports from run artifacts
description:
Implement derived reporting from canonical run artifacts.

Deliverables:
- task status summary
- best-known strategy per task
- simple frontier/best-run report
- no SQLite as canonical state; derive from run logs

title: Implement strategy comparison tooling
description:
Implement strategy-comparison tooling over run artifacts.

Deliverables:
- compare runs by task and strategy
- sort by score and API-call count
- make it easy to answer which strategy is currently best for a task
- emit simple machine-readable and human-readable outputs

title: Implement first production-quality task vertical slice
description:
Create the first production-quality vertical slice task under the new architecture.

Deliverables:
- canonical `task.ts`
- classifier-facing surface
- one deterministic strategy file in the approved style
- enough runtime wiring so the task can execute through replay

Use the current example as a guide, but raise it to production-quality shape.

title: Implement second strategy variant for first task
description:
Add a second strategy variant for the same first task.

Deliverables:
- same task surface
- second concrete strategy with a different solve hypothesis
- both strategies runnable through the same pipeline

This proves the architecture supports actual strategy comparison instead of one-off execution.

title: Seed initial task registry for broader task set
description:
Populate the initial task registry with placeholders/entries for the known task set.

Deliverables:
- stable task ids for the broader task set
- registry entries or placeholders for future tasks
- enough structure that the first vertical slice is not a special case

Do not overbuild the full 30-task implementation yet.

title: Verify iteration-ready workflow on one task
description:
Verify that the new system is genuinely iteration-ready.

Deliverables:
- run at least one replay through the new pipeline
- produce canonical run artifact + any sanitized sidecars
- compare two strategies for one task
- identify the currently best strategy using the comparison tooling

This is the proof point that the architecture is useful for optimization work.

title: Document operator workflow for ongoing strategy iteration
description:
Document the operator workflow for adding and improving strategies after the system is live.

Deliverables:
- how to add a new task surface
- how to add a new strategy
- how to replay and inspect artifacts
- how to compare strategies and promote a winner

This is the handoff into day-to-day strategy iteration.

title: System ready for real strategy iteration
description:
This milestone closes when tripletex2 has:
- deterministic runtime wiring
- canonical run tracking
- comparison tooling
- at least one task with multiple runnable strategies
- a documented workflow for ongoing iteration

At that point the team can stop debating architecture and start optimizing task strategies.

title: Freeze classifier and extractor contract
description:
Freeze the classifier/extractor contract.

Deliverables:
- exact input to classifier/extractor layer
- exact output shape for task identification and extracted values
- representation for confidence / ambiguity / failure
- clear boundary: classifier/extractor returns typed values only, never a solve plan

This should be tight enough that runtime wiring can proceed without further architecture debate.

title: Add legacy Tripletex1 task-id mapping bridge
description: Map live Tripletex1/scoreboard task ids into the canonical tripletex2 task registry so live results can be imported cleanly.

title: Import legacy Tripletex1 run outcomes into canonical evidence
description: Ingest reliable legacy run/task/score evidence from tasks/tripletex into canonical sanitized tripletex2 records without faking precise strategy identity.

title: Add combined live-plus-native task status reporting
description: Report task coverage, best scores, and open optimization targets across imported Tripletex1 evidence and native tripletex2 runs.

title: Freeze run artifact and sanitized sidecar schema
description:
Finalize the canonical run-artifact schema and the optional sanitized sidecar model.

Deliverables:
- one canonical JSON run artifact schema per execution
- explicit attribution/evaluation evidence fields
- clear rules for optional sanitized sidecars
- explicit sanitization rules and secret-handling rules

This locks the evidence model before implementation.

title: Freeze task folder and strategy file template
description:
Lock the per-task code shape.

Deliverables:
- canonical `task.ts` front-door shape
- rules for what belongs in `task.ts`
- rules for what belongs in a strategy file
- complexity-budget guidance so strategy files stay short and legible

This should make future task folders feel copyable and boring.

title: Implement shared runtime contract module
description:
Implement the shared runtime types and helpers that all tasks will import.

Deliverables:
- concrete `TaskSpec`, `TaskStrategy`, `StrategyContext`, and `StrategyResult`
- task/strategy helper exports used by example tasks
- no framework sprawl; keep the surface small and legible
notes: Fulfilled by bd-oqi.1 contract-freeze implementation: canonical runtime contracts now live in src/runtime/contracts.ts and are already used by the example task.

title: Implement task registry and task loading
description:
Implement the task registry and task loading layer.

Deliverables:
- registry shape for task specs
- discovery/loading of task-local `task.ts`
- stable task lookup by `taskId`
- room for eventual 30-task registry without overbuilding now

title: Implement active strategy selection config
description:
Implement active strategy selection config and runtime resolution.

Deliverables:
- config format for active strategy per task
- loader/validator for selection config
- runtime resolution from taskId to selected strategy

The goal is controlled experiments, not dynamic strategy choice.

title: Implement Tripletex client with sanitized call capture
description:
Implement a reusable Tripletex client that also captures sanitized call evidence.

Deliverables:
- HTTP client wrapper for Tripletex
- sanitized request/response summaries
- API-call counting and status tracking
- no credential leakage into logs

This is both runtime plumbing and the basis for run tracking.

title: Implement canonical run artifact writer
description:
Implement the canonical run artifact writer.

Deliverables:
- one JSON artifact per run
- optional sanitized sidecar emission
- attribution/evaluation evidence hooks
- append-only layout under `runs/`

This should match the frozen run-log spec and stay git-friendly.

title: Create task.ts + UnimplementedError strategy for all 17 remaining tasks
description: For each of the 17 tasks that currently have placeholder registrations, create a real task folder with task.ts (typed input surface from trusted standards) and one strategy file that throws UnimplementedError. This makes every task classifiable and routable, even before real strategies exist.

title: Add 300s timeout enforcement for solve requests
description: Enforce the 5-minute (300s) hard deadline on /solve requests. Kill the Codex session and write a timeout artifact if the deadline is exceeded. Match tripletex1 behavior.

title: Wire competition-mode storage and run staging 1:1 with tripletex1
description: Ensure tripletex2's data/production/runs/<runId>/ staging matches tripletex1 exactly: request.json, manifest.json, attachments/, codex-prompt.txt, launch script, leaderboard.before.json, leaderboard.after.json, leaderboard.diff.json, submissions.before.json, submissions.after.json, task-attribution.json, submission-score.json. Also wire TRIPLETEX_STORAGE_MODE env support.
